node.title: Re^3: Installing PadWalker (updated)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
10.0-962.3.2.lve1.5.39.el7.x86_64

I think that's [wp://Red Hat Enterprise Linux|RHEL7] or one of the [wp://Red Hat Enterprise Linux derivatives|many] OSes based on it, like [wp://CentOS]*. Perhaps your hosting provider's support would be willing to answer that question more precisely?

Where else might I find more information so I can look into building a virtual machine or even a physical replica?

I searched for "redhat linux virtualbox" on YouTube and found a bunch of video tutorials. (Just make sure to download stuff from the official pages only.)

* Update: I see you just posted [11130454], which gives more hints: uname='linux buildfarm02.cloudlinux.com ...' suggests [wp://CloudLinux OS], a CentOS derivative.
